pr.body:
## Summary

Turn the demo repository's first honest readiness snapshot into working,
keyless live verification and a protected production deployment path.

## Tickets
| Ticket | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|
| #51 | Enable keyless live GCP verification and production deploy | Implemented |

## Changes

- `.shadow/ci/src/verify.rs`: recognize the existing `app/` Firestore test and npm lockfile instead of reporting false failures
- `.github/workflows/deterministic-dashboard.yml`: authenticate the daily verifier as the dedicated read-only `shadow-verifier` identity and pin Node 24-compatible actions
- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`: add a pinned WIF-only Cloud Run deployment path with immutable image tags
- `app/Dockerfile`: upgrade the runtime to Node 22, use reproducible `npm ci`, and run as the non-root `node` user
- `docs/readiness-ledger.md`: document the strict separation between deploy and verification identities

## Test Plan

- application and Firestore control tests: 11 passed
- workflow YAML and staged diff checks passed
- staging protection now matches main and requires all five security/compliance checks
- protected GitHub CI will run both Rust crates, the app suite, dependency review, compliance gates, and CodeQL

Closes #51
